summary: Delta review. All rework items are done: smooth road ribbons layered ground, ribbons, then tiles on top, with markPavements leaving alley WALK tiles as tiles; ambient traffic is limited to w >= 2; placeDocShops and placeBloTent throw the requested messages; the two new road tests plus a sparse-town test live in test/world-roads.test.js and the locked test/world.test.js is untouched; the five nits are fixed (hasOwnProperty in sim.js, main.js and the converter, pointInPolygon rename, cached in-flight loadMap, attribution dropped, README sentence). npm test (28 pass), npm run e2e and design_check (no findings) are green on this tree. newShopPlot is sound: it only uses 3x3 all-GRASS tiles with a reachable street door at least 20 tiles from the office, it is deterministic and bounded, and it is used only by the mini fixture (4 of 5 shops there). It is never used on Pulivendula. Disabling it makes locked T-2 and the new sparse-town test fail, so the test is meaningful. It is about 18 lines and in proportion. Two minor points remain.

findings.issue: newShopPlot builds a house literal ({x,y,w,h,color,kind:'house',tank,seed} plus g.fill BUILD) that duplicates the plot helper in fillEmptyBlocks (line 344-346). The fallback also makes the 'placed N of 5' throw fire only when there is truly no room, so a CP-2 town with few usable mapped houses will silently get invented shop houses instead of failing loudly. Nothing asserts that real-town shops come from the mapped or filled buildings.
findings.fix: Optional: hoist the house push into one helper shared with fillEmptyBlocks. For CP-2, add a test per real town that checks the fallback is unused, for example by marking the building with fabricated: true and asserting no such building exists in Pulivendula, Kadapa and Punganur.

findings.issue: Previous minor (HUD town-name check matches any canvas string containing 'Pulivendula') was not in the judge's rework list and is unchanged. It is accepted as out of scope.
findings.fix: Optional: match the HUD string exactly.
